# YuE2 Studio

> A Linux studio for YuE2 (M-A-P) - a fork of timoncool/YuE2-Studio without the Windows desktop shell - which writes a score in ABC notation and then sings it, running on the user's own NVIDIA card (CPU works too, slowly). While it is open it serves an MCP server at http://127.0.0.1:8791/mcp that an agent uses to do everything the studio does: songs from a style and lyrics, editable scores, covers of recordings, the library, covers, stems, MIDI from any track, karaoke, audio processing, video clips, the player, LoRA, and a LoRA trained from a folder of songs end to end. The agent also sees the studio's window and works it like a user.

For an agent given this repository: build the service (`cargo build --release -p music-server`), the UI (`npm --prefix app run build`) and the engine (`./scripts/build-yue-runtime.sh --output dist/yue2-cpp`), start it (`./scripts/run-linux.sh --build`), connect to its MCP server, and read the skill the server serves (resource `studio://skill`, prompt `studio`) - it names every tool, what the model reads, and the recipes. Start every session with the tool `studio_status`.

## Connect

- MCP endpoint: `http://127.0.0.1:8791/mcp` (Streamable HTTP; protocol 2026-07-28 stateless, and 2025-11-25 / 2025-06-18 / 2025-03-26 through `initialize`)
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http yue2-studio http://127.0.0.1:8791/mcp`
- Other clients: `{ "mcpServers": { "yue2-studio": { "type": "streamable-http", "url": "http://127.0.0.1:8791/mcp" } } }`
- Only agents on this computer and the studio's own window may connect; there is no key.

## Docs

- [Agent skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asb-42/yue2-studio/main/docs/mcp-skill.md): every tool by area, the model's writing rules, step-by-step recipes (the same text the server serves as `studio://skill`)
- [README](https://github.com/asb-42/yue2-studio#readme): what the studio does, what it needs, models and where they go
- [Latest release](https://github.com/asb-42/yue2-studio/releases): Linux tarballs (no installer; see README)

## Optional

- Install the skill for Claude Code: save [docs/mcp-skill.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asb-42/yue2-studio/main/docs/mcp-skill.md) as `~/.claude/skills/yue2-studio/SKILL.md`
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/asb-42/yue2-studio/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
